name: LanternHouse
description: Dom do samodzielnego złożenia ze sklejki. Zawiera projekt do wydruku i samodzielnego wycięcia lub wydrukowania laserowego / CNC.

paragraphs: A plywood dollhouse that is entirely generated from code. One Python model and one config file produce the FreeCAD CAD, the nested cut sheets, a printable A4 building book with 1:1 templates, the renders and an interactive 3D viewer. Automated checks prove that the walls, doors, drawer and roof all move clear of each other.

The house is a round blue tower with a red spire roof, three floors and an attic. All plywood parts fit A3 stock (297 × 420 mm). CNC machining and calibrated A4 templates support company cutting and DIY work. The front walls swing open on real hinges, the roof with its two dormers lifts off, a permanent veranda with a rope ladder stands on the side, a back door leads to the woodpile, and a drawer is hidden in the stone plinth. Four thermo-clay figures live in the house: the Rowan family (Elias, Mira, Ada and Theo).
Lanternwood House is an original open-source design for a hand-crafted wooden dollhouse and polymer clay figures. See Licence.
features: A real build, not just a model. Every part has a plywood thickness, an outline, its holes and its jigsaw starter holes, packed onto real sheet sizes. The book contains tiled 1:1 templates with a calibration square,…

Play features. Two front wall shells open to 100°, where a magnet sealed inside a small garden post holds each one open; catches under the attic floor hold them shut. Three entrance doors open outward and each floor has…
One config drives everything. Height, base, plinth, drawer, doors, veranda position and size, hinge hole patterns, plywood stock and colours all live in source/config.json.

Checked automatically. Every build checks for solid overlaps, samples the wall swing every 5° up to the 100° stop and sweeps all six doors. It also checks drawer travel to its stop, roof lift, window clearance, that…

Clay figures. Elias, Mira, Ada and Theo Rowan are signed-distance "lumps" pressed together like real clay. The build computes each figure's volume, the grams of clay per colour, and the saving from a foil core.
